description:
This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform size selection steps on 48-96 input samples. User-determined parameters are available for selection of the labware for the library prep plate and the size plate.
Links:
 Part 1: Enzymatic Fragmentation and End Prep
 Part 2: Sample Cleanup for Covaris Samples
 Part 3: End Prep
 Part 4: Adapter Ligation
 Part 5: Size Selection
 Part 6: Clean Up
 Part 7: PCR Enrichment
 Part 8: Sample Clean Up
 Part 9: Fragment Analyzer
 Part 10: Pooling According to Concentration
